patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background colors or imagery, often featuring centered content blocks or large typography.
Grid-based presentation for certain content, such as the initial menu on the 'About' page or the team photos.
A vibrant and diverse accent color palette is used for full-bleed section backgrounds, contrasting with a predominantly black and white base for text and main structural elements.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used to introduce sections, creating strong visual anchors.
Sections dynamically reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as the user scrolls, creating a guided narrative flow.
The 'About' page features a unique full-screen, grid-based navigation/menu for its sub-sections, each with a distinct background color and a simple geometric outline.

technique_notes: A full-width video serves as a dynamic hero background, playing on loop beneath overlaid text.

The site utilizes scroll-triggered animations to progressively reveal content sections. As each section enters the viewport, it subtly fades in and translates upwards, creating a smooth, staggered appearance.
The main navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between full-width content sections, creating clear visual breaks.

standout: The site stands out with its eclectic, almost art-gallery-like presentation of diverse creative projects and a playful, vibrant color palette that injects personality into each section. The full-screen, grid-based menu on the 'About' page is a distinctive and engaging way to navigate internal content.
